note: Seed set for the battery-passport submodel (46 indexed nodes, 11 enriched from concept descriptions). Every path was taken from the built index, not written from the template, so a case that fails fails on retrieval rather than on a typo. Tiers are reported separately: verbatim is a floor and proves nothing, paraphrase is the measurement, multilingual and negative probe specific weaknesses. HUMAN REVIEW WANTED on the `acceptable` lists -- several queries have more than one defensible target and the judgement about which is left to a domain reader.
